| Starbie PCB (star shape) | 104.00 x 93.50 mm, 2 layers, 1.6 mm, HASL, green. Just over the 100 mm tier so not the very cheapest price. 5-board minimum, so about $3.00 a batch plus shipping. Price is an estimate. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | JLCPCB |
| Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3 | The brain. Order the castellated SMD version you routed for. Price from the Seeed product page. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | Seeed Studio |
| DHT11 temp + humidity | Digital one-wire sensor on D0. Price from the Tayda listing, which is often out of stock; Adafruit stocks the same part for more money. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | Tayda Electronics |
| MPU6050 6-axis accelerometer (GY-521 module) | REQUIRED and was missing from this list before. Not a PCB part - it plugs into J2 pins 1-4 (3V3, GND, SCL, SDA), which exists exactly for it. Without it the tilt menu never moves. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | ElectroPeak |
| WS2812B addressable RGB | LCSC C114586. The eyes. Data is chained D1 -> D2, so solder them in that order. Driven through R3 on D6/GPIO21. Minimum order 5. | 2 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| 1x04 pin header (OLED) | Solder the OLED module straight to the board or fit a socket first. Price is an estimate for the header alone. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | Generic |
| 0.96in 128x64 SSD1306 I2C OLED module | Sits on J1. Most are address 0x3C; some are 0x3D - change OLED_ADDRESS in the firmware if yours is. Adafruit's equivalent breakout is $17.50 (https://www.adafruit.com/product/326). Price is an estimat | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | Generic |
| 1x08 pin header | Carries 3V3, GND, SCL, SDA on pins 1-4 for the MPU6050; pins 5-8 are spare. Price is an estimate. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | Generic |
| 1x02 pin header (motor) | Vibration motor connector. Price is an estimate. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | Generic |
| Cherry MX keyswitch | PCB-mount MX, 1.00u. Any MX-compatible switch fits (Cherry, Gateron, Kailh). Price is an estimate; I could not confirm a current listing. | 2 | $0.00 | $0.00 | AliExpress |
| AO3400A N-channel MOSFET | LCSC C20917. Low-side switch for the motor. Must be logic-level - it is specified at 2.5 V gate drive so it works from 3.3 V. Minimum order 5. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| SS14 Schottky diode | Flyback across the motor, cathode to +3.3V. Part number taken from the build guide rather than re-checked. A 1N4148W works too (LCSC C81598, $0.0125, 50-piece minimum). | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| 22uF capacitor 0805 | LCSC C129302 (X5R, 16 V). Motor bulk capacitor. Minimum order 10. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| 100nF capacitor 0805 | LCSC C1711 (Samsung, 50 V, X7R). Minimum order 20. | 3 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| 10k resistor (through-hole) | Pull-up on the DHT11 data line. This is the part that holds GPIO2 HIGH at power-on, so do not omit it. Price is an estimate. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | Generic |
| 10k resistor 0805 | LCSC C17414. Top half of the light divider. Minimum order 100 - you will have spares. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| 330 ohm resistor 0805 | Series resistor for the WS2812B data line. Any 0805 1% 0.1 W part. Price is an estimate based on the 0805 family. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| GL5528 photoresistor (LDR) | LCSC C10081. Bottom half of the light divider. Check your LDR's leg pitch - if it is 2.54 mm use OptoDevice:R_LDR_4.9x4.2mm_P2.54mm_Vertical instead. Minimum order 10. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| 220 ohm resistor 0805 | Motor gate series resistor. Price is an estimate based on the 0805 family. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| 100k resistor 0805 | Motor gate pull-down - stops the motor twitching on boot. Price is an estimate based on the 0805 family. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| 100 ohm resistor 0805 | Buzzer series resistor (sets the volume). Price is an estimate based on the 0805 family. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| Piezo buzzer PS1240P02BT | TDK PS1240P02BT, LCSC C76871. It must be PASSIVE (externally driven) - an active buzzer can only make one fixed beep. Minimum order 1. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | LCSC |
| Vibration motor (coin type, 1027) | Not a PCB part - it plugs into J3 and is stuck to the board. 10 x 2.7 mm, 3 V, brushed ERM. Buy two, they are easy to kill. Price is an estimate. | 1 | $0.00 | $0.00 | AliExpress |
| Keycaps (MX, 1u) | For SW1/SW2. Price is an estimate. | 2 | $0.00 | $0.00 | AliExpress |
